library(tidyverse)
library(WebPower)
output<-function(d){d$type<-as.numeric(as.character(d$type)); d$tails<-as.character(d$tails); for(i in 1:nrow(d)){if(d$test[i]=='anova'){d$small[i]<-wp.rmanova(d$n[i],d$ng[i],d$nm[i],f=0.1,nscor=1,alpha=0.05,power=NULL,type=d$type[i])$power; d$medium[i]<-wp.rmanova(d$n[i],d$ng[i],d$nm[i],f=0.25,nscor=1,alpha=0.05,power=NULL,type=d$type[i])$power; d$large[i]<-wp.rmanova(d$n[i],d$ng[i],d$nm[i],f=0.4,nscor=1,alpha=0.05,power=NULL,type=d$type[i])$power; d$p80[i]<-wp.rmanova(d$n[i],d$ng[i],d$nm[i],f=NULL,nscor=1,alpha=0.05,power=.80,type=d$type[i])$f*2; d$p95[i]<-wp.rmanova(d$n[i],d$ng[i],d$nm[i],f=NULL,nscor=1,alpha=0.05,power=.95,type=d$type[i])$f*2}}; d}
d<-read.csv('/data/fMRInf_regulation.csv'); d<-output(d); dTrial<-d%>%filter(pilot=='N'); t<-dTrial%>%summarize(mean(n),mean(small),mean(medium),mean(large),mean(p80),mean(p95)); print(t); cat('mean_p80=', t[[5]][1], '\n')
EOF
